description: React component for rendering code blocks with syntax highlighting, copy, and download functionality.

classes.name: CodeBlock
classes.description: React memoized component for displaying syntax-highlighted code with copy and download features.

methods.name: handleClosePopOver
methods.description: Closes the popover indicating copy success.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies code value to clipboard and shows success popover.

methods.name: downloadAsFile
methods.description: Downloads the code as a file with appropriate extension based on language.
